'''Wilber Flagesso''' was a member of the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Flagesso held the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] within the Guard. While outwardly loyal to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], he was actually in league with [[Sawthawne]], and attempted to stage a coup when Calrissian shut down the crime boss. His attempts were foiled, however, and he was arrested after fleeing to the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]]. Flagesso had the picture-perfect good looks of a model on a recruiting poster. He owned a [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]].
